course.title: Vector, Matrix and Ordinary Differential Equation

content.value: A body of temperature $8 0 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { F }$ is placed in a room of constant temperature $5 0 \%$ at time $t =$ 0. At the end of 5 minutes, the body has cooled to a temperature of $7 0 \mathrm { { ^ \circ F } }$ . Find the temperature of the body at the end of 10 minutes. After how many times, the temperature of the body will be within $1 ^ { \circ } \mathrm { F }$ compared to the room temperature?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 1st Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2021
